title: Dot product of concatenated vectors
statement: For natural numbers $n,m$, vectors $a,x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and vectors $b,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^m$, the dot product of the concatenations of $a$ with $b$ and $x$ with $y$ equals the sum of the dot products of $a$ with $x$ and $b$ with $y$.
